messages:
anna_support: Customer reported a 500 when invoking the price_lookup tool; they also say they were billed twice for the same call. cc @liam_engineering @sophia_ml
liam_engineering: ugh. got the forwarded request — looks like the tool args were a string not an object, schema validator threw and downstream billing hook still recorded usage :/ can you paste the request?
anna_support: paste from customer (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -d '{
  "model":"gpt-psi-1",
  "tool":"price_lookup",
  "args":"{\"sku\":\"ACME-9000\", \"currency\":\"USD\"}"
}'
```
liam_engineering: yep — args is a JSON string. Our schema validator should reject that earlier. logs: `validation: type_mismatch args expected object got string -> 400` but billing hook received `request_id=rq_78abc` and recorded token usage before error path finished.
sophia_ml: interestingly, our golden-eval CI picks this up intermittently. qa_evals: we started seeing flaky failures in toolcall-schema-tests yesterday: some runs fail with `schema mismatch` while others pass. hypotheses: parallelism in CI or model variant differences returning different arg shapes?
qa_evals: repro in CI: run `./ci/toolcall-schema-test --seed=42 --model=gpt-psi-1` -> ~1/20 runs fail. attaching small log: `toolcall-test: [seed=42] run=7 -> mismatch at args.price_type optional_field_present=true`
liam_engineering: that aligns — if model variant includes extra optional fields sometimes, our validator may be strict. But the double billing is a separate bug: billing codepath shouldn't charge on validation error.
devops_bot: ticket created: #5467 (support-billing-toolcall) — owner assigned: liam_engineering.
liam_engineering: plan: 1) quick mitigation — make billing hook idempotent and only record usage on successful response path. 2) add a defensive pre-validator that coerces stringified JSON args (try parse) before schema validation so we don't accidentally error for common client bug. 3) add a CI golden test that fuzzes arg typing to catch flakiness.
anna_support: customer wants a timeline and a credit. can we patch and issue immediate credit?
liam_engineering: will deploy a hotfix to billing hook (idempotency & early abort) to canary tonight. estimated rollout: 1 hour for canary -> if stable promote to prod. will issue manual credit once canary shows non-duplicate charges — @sophia_ml can you confirm if any eval regressions are from recent model onboarding?
sophia_ml: looking at model catalog, gpt-psi-1 had a minor tokenizer update and a new fast variant rolled last week; that could explain optional field noise. i'll pin the model in the eval harness to stable variant and add a regression test that asserts tool args are an object type across seeds.
qa_evals: adding a golden prompt to CI: we will add a deterministic prompt that always triggers the tool and assert exact schema shape. also adding `--repeat 100 --seed X` job to catch 1/20 flakes.
liam_engineering: repro steps for devs: 1) run local server, 2) send the malformed curl above, 3) check logs at /var/log/redwood/toolcall.log for `validation: type_mismatch`, 4) audit billing entries with `SELECT * FROM billing.events WHERE request_id='rq_78abc'`
anna_support: thanks. i've responded to customer that we're on it and will issue credit. :thumbsup:
devops_bot: deploy started: billing-hook-hotfix -> canary (node: canary-02).
liam_engineering: canary looks good, no duplicate charge events after 30m smoke. promoting.
sophia_ml: i pushed eval changes and pinned model variant in CI. initial run: 200 repeats -> 0/200 failures.
qa_evals: golden CI added to main branch. will monitor for 48h.
anna_support: customer credited and notified. closing on the support ticket pending 48h of CI stability.
liam_engineering: followup: we'll schedule a tech debt task to add stricter billing integration tests in our staging environment so this can't happen again. assigning to infra backlog.
anna_support: thanks everyone. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
